title: Architecture Case Metadata
description: Metadata sidecar for VAMS architecture case documents (.docx or .md). One JSON per document, same base filename. Drives both SA discoverability and automated Atlas tooling.

id.description: Unique kebab-case identifier. Must start with 'case-'. Must match the document/json base filename. Example: case-b2b-split-payment

title.description: Human-readable case title. Used as the primary search anchor and display label.

docxFile.description: Filename of the associated document file (basename only, no path). Must match the id. Accepts .docx or .md. Examples: case-b2b-split-payment.docx, case-b2b-split-payment.md

version.description: Semantic version of this case document. Bump MINOR for content updates, PATCH for corrections.

status.description: Lifecycle state. Automated tooling only indexes Approved cases by default.

createdBy.description: Full name or SA alias of the original author.

commerce.description: Structured e-commerce technology profile of the solution. Pure filter signal — not in the docx. Enables pre-filtering before vector search and cross-case comparison in Atlas tooling.

vectorStore.description: Pipeline-managed. Written by the RAG ingestion pipeline after vectorisation. Never authored by SAs.

context.description: The problem space. Describes the customer situation that motivates the case.

industry.description: Industries the customer operates in. Used as a primary facet filter.

businessModel.description: Business models in scope for this case.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes relevant to this case.

customerSize.description: Approximate size of the customer this case applies to. Used for scoping and discoverability.

summary.description: One-paragraph description of the business problem and its origin. This is the primary full-text search field for the context group.

painPoints.description: Specific pain points or challenges the customer faced. Each item is a short statement (one sentence max).

constraints.description: Technical, business, or organisational constraints that shaped the solution. Optional but strongly recommended.

solution.description: The proposed solution. Captures pattern, technologies, decisions, and implementation details.

pattern.description: Short name of the architectural pattern applied. Used as a facet filter and display label. Examples: 'Event-driven middleware', 'Headless checkout', 'Franchise account topology'.

summary.description: Concise description of the proposed solution — what was built, how it works, and why this approach was chosen. Primary full-text search field for the solution group.

vtexProducts.description: VTEX products and capabilities central to this solution. Free-form to avoid schema churn as the product catalogue evolves.

externalIntegrations.description: Third-party systems or services integrated in this solution (ERP, WMS, PIM, PSP, etc.).

architectureFileRef.description: Filename (basename only) of the associated VAMS architecture JSON file, if one exists. Example: b2b-customer-credit.json

keyDecisions.description: The most important architectural decisions made in this solution. Each entry captures the decision and its rationale — the parts that don't fit in the pattern name or summary.

implementationComplexity.description: Overall implementation complexity as assessed by the authoring SA. Used for tooling filters and comparison.

estimatedTimeline.description: Indicative delivery timeline. Free-form (e.g. '6–10 weeks', '3 months'). Not a commitment.

implementationNotes.description: Optional. Key gotchas, sequencing advice, or configuration notes that SAs should know before attempting this pattern.

decision.description: What was decided. State it as a fact, not a question. Example: 'Use VTEX IO middleware instead of an external integration layer'.

rationale.description: Why this decision was made. Include what was traded away.

alternativesConsidered.description: Other options that were evaluated and rejected.

tradeoffs.description: Structured analysis of the solution. Drives both human review and automated scoring/comparison tooling.

pros.description: Benefits and advantages of this solution. Each item is a concrete statement (not generic).

cons.description: Drawbacks, limitations, or trade-offs of this solution. Must be honest — cases with no cons will be rejected in review.

risks.description: Known risks associated with this solution pattern.

recommendedWhen.description: Conditions under which this solution is a good fit. Used by Atlas tooling to surface relevant cases.

avoidWhen.description: Conditions under which this solution should NOT be used. Critical for automated tooling to filter out mismatched cases.

tradeoffScores.description: Structured 1–5 scores for key dimensions. 1 = poor/expensive/slow, 5 = excellent/cheap/fast. All required to enable cross-case comparison in Atlas tooling.

implementationCost.description: 1 = very expensive to implement, 5 = very cheap. Consider dev time, licences, and infrastructure.

operationalCost.description: 1 = high ongoing cost (custom infra, manual ops), 5 = low (fully managed, no overhead).

scalability.description: 1 = does not scale (tightly coupled, stateful), 5 = scales horizontally with no architectural changes.

maintainability.description: 1 = hard to maintain (custom code, brittle integrations), 5 = easy (native APIs, well-documented patterns).

vtexNativeAlignment.description: 1 = heavily customised or external (high upgrade risk), 5 = fully native VTEX with no customisation.

timeToMarket.description: 1 = slow (6+ months), 5 = fast (< 4 weeks). Based on estimatedTimeline.

flexibility.description: 1 = locks the customer into a single pattern (hard to change), 5 = easily adapted or replaced without major rework.

severity.description: Potential impact if the risk materialises.

mitigation.description: Recommended mitigation strategy. Optional but strongly recommended for High and Critical risks.

classification.description: Discoverability and cross-referencing metadata. Critical for both search and automated Atlas indexing.

tags.description: Free-form keywords for full-text search. Use consistently across the case library (e.g. 'B2B', 'Payments', 'ERP Integration').

architecturePattern.description: High-level architectural pattern name. Should match solution.pattern unless the classification-level name is more abstract.

vtexLayer.description: VTEX platform layers touched by this solution. Used as a primary facet filter in Atlas.

complexity.description: Denormalised from solution.implementationComplexity for tooling convenience. Must match.

relatedCases.description: IDs of other architecture cases that are related.

relatedArchitectures.description: Filenames (basename only) of VAMS solution architecture JSON files that relate to this case.

supersedes.description: ID of an older case that this one replaces.

supersededBy.description: ID of a newer case that replaces this one. Set when status = Deprecated.

commerce.description: Structured e-commerce technology profile of the solution. All properties optional to allow incremental adoption. This block is the pre-filter layer for RAG retrieval — it is NOT duplicated in the docx.

businessModel.description: One or more business models covered by this architecture.

accountType.description: VTEX account topology. 'Standard' = single merchant. 'Marketplace' = covers the marketplace account and all its sellers.

sellerType.description: Types of sellers present. Only relevant when accountType is 'Marketplace'.

multiAccount.description: True when the implementation spans multiple VTEX accounts (e.g. franchise networks, sub-accounts per region).

marketplace.description: Marketplace governance rules. Required when accountType is 'Marketplace'.

channels.description: Customer-facing sales and interaction channels covered by this architecture.

cdn.description: CDN provider used for storefront delivery.

multiLanguage.description: True when the implementation serves content in more than one language.

multiCurrency.description: True when the implementation supports more than one currency.

tradePolicies.description: Number of VTEX trade policies configured in this architecture.

searchProvider.description: Search and discovery engine in use.

catalogSource.description: System of record for product catalog data.

hasPricePerCustomer.description: True when customer-specific or contract-based pricing is in use (B2B price tables, PROS, etc.).

paymentMethods.description: Payment methods and gateways integrated. Free-form strings to accommodate the full vendor landscape.

antiFraud.description: Anti-fraud provider integrated with VTEX Payment Hub.

paymentSplitModel.description: Payment split/intermediation model. Only relevant when accountType is 'Marketplace'.

hasSubscriptions.description: True when VTEX Subscriptions or equivalent recurring order flow is implemented.

hasGiftCard.description: True when gift card as a payment method or product is part of the architecture.

hasLoyalty.description: True when a loyalty or points programme is integrated.

hasCustomerCredit.description: True when VTEX Customer Credit or a charge-account/net-terms payment flow is implemented.

omsProvider.description: Order management system. Use 'External' when VTEX OMS is bypassed.

fulfillmentModel.description: Fulfilment strategies covered by this architecture.

hasReturnsFlow.description: True when a returns flow (VTEX Returns App or custom) is part of the architecture.

multiWarehouse.description: True when inventory spans multiple warehouses or fulfilment centres.

hasStorePickup.description: True when click-and-collect / BOPIS is supported.

hasSameDayDelivery.description: True when same-day delivery via a last-mile partner is part of the architecture.

hasOrderReconciliation.description: True when a financial order reconciliation flow between marketplace and sellers exists.

erp.description: ERP system integrated with VTEX (e.g. SAP, Oracle EBS, Linx).

wms.description: Warehouse management system integrated with VTEX (e.g. Korber, custom).

pim.description: Product information management system (e.g. Salsify, Stibo, Akeneo).

crm.description: CRM system integrated for customer data (e.g. Salesforce, Oracle CX).

identityProvider.description: Identity / SSO provider used alongside VTEX ID.

dataWarehouse.description: Data warehouse or lakehouse receiving VTEX data (e.g. Snowflake, BigQuery).

cdpOrPersonalization.description: CDP or personalisation tools integrated (e.g. Adobe Target, Criteo, Segment).

hasDataPipeline.description: True when VTEX Data Pipeline is explicitly configured for data export.

region.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 country codes covered by this architecture.

language.description: BCP 47 language tags for the locales supported (e.g. en-US, pt-BR, es-CO).

marketplaceGovernance.description: Governance rules defining ownership responsibilities between the marketplace operator and its sellers. Required when commerce.accountType is 'Marketplace'.

priceOwnership.description: Who sets the final consumer price.

catalogOwnership.description: Who owns the product catalog master data.

fulfillmentOwnership.description: Who is responsible for order fulfilment logistics.

sellerOnboarding.description: How sellers are onboarded onto the marketplace.

vectorStore.description: Pipeline-managed block. Written by the RAG ingestion pipeline after vectorisation. Never authored manually by SAs. Present only after the first successful ingestion run.

indexedAt.description: Timestamp of the last successful vectorisation run for this document.

chunkIds.description: Map of docx section name to vector store chunk ID. Keys are fixed section names; values are the IDs assigned by the vector store after ingestion.

context.description: Vector ID for the Context section chunk.

solution.description: Vector ID for the Proposed Solution section chunk.

tradeoffs.description: Vector ID for the Trade-off Analysis section chunk.

relatedCases.description: Vector ID for the Related Cases section chunk. Optional — only present if the section exists in the docx.
